text: Ever seen someone whisper to their biceps?
Mind-muscle connection sounds like gym magic. So researchers tested it.
For eight weeks, one group focused on squeezing their biceps during curls. The other just lifted the weight.
The focused group's biceps grew about twelve percent, versus seven. For the quads, there was no clear difference.
So it's real. Use it on small muscles like curls, not your big lifts. Save this.
